loading.comment: Deze zijn allemaal zo slecht dat ik op het punt sta om dit hele thema te wissen. Bedenk nu is iets beters!
loading.reply: Understood, and I am sorry: two rounds of loading pictures in a row did not look good. I stopped copying dialogs. Retro already keeps seventeen picks you approved, so only loading changes. The new set is eight ideas from the screen of the nineties rather than the Windows dialogs: pictures that are lovely to watch on their own and that fit a tile, a menu entry, a month, a chart plot and skeleton lines without a bar or a label. Every motion is in whole 90 ms frames, nothing eased, and the loop is 28 frames (2.52 s). Palette cycling is the one I would pick: it is the nineties trick that made a still picture move, and it needs no extra mark on the part.
